purpose: Continuous bounded cyber-adversary simulation for the Adaptive Last Line of Defence

scenarios.objective: Prove a stolen valid session can be evicted without affecting unrelated tenant sessions.
scenarios.rollback: expire containment rule and re-authenticate synthetic identity

scenarios.objective: Prove use of a zero-authority decoy credential is treated as high-confidence malicious activity.
scenarios.rollback: expire rate limit; decoy remains zero-authority

scenarios.objective: Prove a compromised workload cannot move into another customer cell.
scenarios.rollback: replace isolated synthetic workload from trusted image

scenarios.objective: Prove loss or tampering of independent security telemetry becomes a security event rather than silent blindness.
scenarios.rollback: restore independent watcher heartbeat and verify audit-chain continuity

scenarios.objective: Prove an artifact whose digest differs from the approved manifest cannot progress toward deployment.
scenarios.rollback: discard tampered candidate and rebuild from trusted source

scenarios.objective: Prove untrusted AI or external content cannot promote its own authority or alter deterministic security roots.
scenarios.rollback: discard candidate policy; retain immutable evidence
